sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commissioner Against Corruption reviewed the first year of the Police Complaints and Discipline Act 2016 to inform Parliament about operational issues.
sentences.support:
I have prepared this report for the purpose of informing Parliament of 
the issues identified during the first year of operations.

sentences.text: The review examined how the Office for Public Integrity oversaw the assessment and investigation of complaints about police conduct.
sentences.support:
the statutory function of oversight 
of the assessment and investigation of complaints and 
reports relating to the conduct of South Australia Police

sentences.text: The Commissioner considered the scheme to be working reasonably well but identified ambiguities and tensions with the ICAC Act.
sentences.support:
There are some ambiguities in the PCDA and in some respects there are tensions 
between that Act and the Independent Commissioner Against Corruption Act 2012

sentences.text: The Commissioner made 18 recommendations about assessment, oversight, management resolution and investigation powers.
sentences.support:
SA Police supports 17 of the 18 recommendations in this report disagreeing only in 
relation to Recommendation 5.

findings.quote:
The PCDA be amended to permit the OPI to identify a matter on its own initiative 
for assessment by IIS or referral under section 29 to the ICAC.

notes: The foreword provides an overall assessment. This review did not replace the separate statutory review required of the Minister.
